summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Official Tutorial Video ## Introduction to Animation p03: Controlling Fixed Pins and Wind Through Keys ### Overview Hello everyone! Today, we are going to introduce how to use the key in Marvelous Designer. ### Recording Animation First of all, when you are recording an animation, you can select the anti-activation fixer to record some special effects. We can manually pause the recording, activate the fixer, and then continue to record the animation. ### Adding Keys Sometimes, we need to select the key or the anti-activation fixer in a specific frame. At this time, we need to use a function to add a key: 1. **Select a Fixed Frame**: First, select a fixed frame. 2. **Add Key**: Click the progress bar at the top of the timeline on the right to select "Add Key." The current fixed frame property will be stored on the key. 3. **Drag Timeline**: Then, drag the timeline to another frame and select the anti-activation fixer, then choose "Add Key." In the next frame, the fixed frame will be in the state of anti-activation. If you choose to perform the anti-activation or activation operation on the fixed frame first and then drag the timeline, it will not work. So, you must drag it to the appropriate frame first, then perform the operation on the fixed frame, and finally click "Add Key." ### Specific Frame Location In addition, whether it is to locate a specific frame or to set the playback area, it is possible to enter a specific value. After recording the animation, you can see that it can be set to a specific value. ### Playback Controls The fixed frame can be directly set from the follow-the-textbook agent. In addition to the view naûrer setting, there are also various control objects associated with it: 1. **Timeline Adjustment**: First, drag the timeline to a suitable number on the disk. 2. **Control Key Activation**: Choose and activate the control key, then add the button. ### Wind Control Settings There are different controls on the control key to use, including pausing and holding the mouse icon. The fourth key cannot be changed as an array. You can see that the wind speed will gradually increase from the last key to this key. - **Reduction Value**: This means that the wind speed will be reduced in the form of a bubble line. When the value is 0, the wind is blowing in a straight line. - **Wind Frequency**: This is used to set the wind frequency. According to the setting of the second value, the wind will suddenly become stronger and weaker. When the value is 0, it means that there is no frequency and the wind is blowing at a fixed speed. - **Irregular Wind Blow**: The higher the value, the more irregularly it blows. When the value is 0, the wind is blowing irregularly. ### Wind Type and Control The type of wind can also be changed to a ball wind, which will blow in the direction of the wind control unit. These are all settings that can be controlled by the key. Furthermore, the position of the wind control unit can also be controlled by the key. If you are chasing the wind controller, the angle can also be controlled by the key. ### Conclusion Finally, after starting the game, you can see that the key of the wind controller has been applied, and the properties will be gradually changed. This is the end of the video. Thank you for your viewing! Please subscribe to the channel. Thank you. ```
